question: Does selection-weighted Mendelian gene transmission, as opposed to channel-preserving genotype-neutral transmission, change unconditional 80-generation persistence under the same ecological visitor histories and identical founder genomes?

selection_mechanism.selected: Original reproduce_kb biological viability ledger and original population.advance (source-selected father/mother sampling and unlinked diploid Mendelian segregation).
selection_mechanism.neutral: Run original reproduce_kb and original advance to determine native Poisson offspring count and the original selfed/outcross recruit totals. Replace ALL newly recruited genome/allele-origin/flags by new Mendelian offspring drawn from uniformly random source parent indices, conditional on the exact self/outcross recruit counts; preserve all offspring IDs and birth-year, original census/visitor states and no mutation. Channel totals remain exactly the source realized values; focal genotype-associated parentage advantage is neutralized.
selection_mechanism.mathematical_null: For every nonempty parent census C, E[offspring allele dosage conditional on Nrecruits>0 and realized source self/outcross counts] equals parental mean for each of the three diploid trait loci under uniform self and uniform ordered distinct-parent outcross sampling.
remaining_mechanisms: trait-induced absolute viable seed production and census feedback
selection_mechanism.removed_mechanism: Within-channel genotype-fitness-dependent parentage transmission (selection-biased inheritance conditional on source channel counts).

analysis.primary: absolute paired history difference p(N80>0 | selected-source Mendelian parentage) - p(N80>0 | channel-preserving neutral Mendelian parentage), separately by K x budget x gate, unconditional across exactly 64 histories
secondary: final allele means among true survivors only
difference in mean allele frequencies relative to founders separately by arm
number of source selfed and outcrossed recruits, descriptive only
analysis.exact_interval: 95% conservative simultaneous Bonferroni Clopper-Pearson paired discordance proportion interval
analysis.decision: supported positive if exact lower >+0.05; supported negative if exact upper <−0.05; practical equivalence only if entire exact interval lies in ±0.05; otherwise inconclusive
analysis.sample_stop: all 64 ecological visitor histories, all 8 K/budget/gate cells; no early stopping or removing extinct histories
negative_controls: native population.advance parity when selection arm
exact realized self/outcross recruit counts retained under neutral assignment
same founder genome/visitors and RNG stream master per history across arms
all three neutral parent conditional expected allele dosages equal source population allele means
monomorphic all-genotype fixture must have identical occupancy under neutral and native for every paired seed
zero founder/census pathways are absorbing with undefined allele frequency after extinction
analysis.unit_of_inference: model-generated visitor RNG history: demographic repeats nested; no independent island ecological species/system replication

disallowed_claims: physically valid ecological redistribution of per-mother viable ovules
proves evolutionary suicide or evolutionarily adaptive selfing
independently preregistered field data or ecological systems
scientific_context: post-outcome motivated by prior #452 gamma-seed/long-horizon unresolvable controls; no parameter selection after this outcome is permitted without explicit exploratory label
